name: Tusculum University
academic_ranking: Regional University (South). U.S. News & World Report 2025-2026: #86 (tie) of 90 Regional Universities (South). Washington Monthly 2025: 341 of 604 Master's Universities. Tennessee's first university and the 28th-oldest operating college in the U.S.
financial_aid: Federal College Scorecard reports Pell Grant recipient rate of ~46.4%. Private university with need- and merit-based aid; most students receive some form of financial aid. Specific average award amounts not publicly confirmed on official pages checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Pioneers softball competes at the on-campus softball complex in Tusculum/Greeneville, TN. Detailed facility specs not published on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the South Atlantic Conference (SAC), a strong D2 conference in the Southeast. Program branded as Tusculum Pioneers.
notes: Softball coaches directory (https://www.tusculumpioneers.com/sports/sball/coaches/index) checked 2026-07 lists only the head coach; no assistant coaches, coordinators, or graduate/volunteer assistants are publicly listed. Roster size (25) from the 2026-27 roster page (https://www.tusculumpioneers.com/sports/sball/2026-27/roster). Tuition ($29,250, in-state = out-of-state) and Pell rate from U.S. Dept. of Education College Scorecard (latest). Federal data lists the school city as Greeneville, TN; the campus community is Tusculum, TN. Scholarship count not publicly listed (D2 softball is equivalency-limited).
